name: Perforce
description: Inspect Perforce depots, changelists, shelves, workspaces, jobs, reviews, and streams.
installHint: Runs the official Perforce P4 MCP Server bundled in the Sandbox Server image in read-only mode. Add a separate named connection for each Perforce server. Supply a login ticket from `p4 login -p` as process-local P4PASSWD; it remains encrypted in this connection's MCP environment and does not require a shared P4TICKETS file. P4CLIENT is intentionally omitted; set a workspace later only when client-specific operations are needed.

envFields.label: Perforce server
envFields.helperText: P4PORT for this connection, including ssl: when the server requires TLS.

envFields.label: Perforce username
envFields.helperText: P4USER used to connect to this Perforce server.

envFields.label: Perforce login ticket
envFields.helperText: Generate a ticket with `p4 login -p`. It is supplied as process-local P4PASSWD and remains encrypted in this connection's MCP environment.
